integrity: The proof derives feasibility directly from multipartite neighborhoods and proves the minimum using a capacitated Hall placement. The verifier independently enumerates all labels, checks neighborhoods, reconstructs part counts, validates multinomial coefficients, and compares minima.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The exact minimum is expressed as a finite optimization over subsets of fully colored parts.
The exhaustive verifier covers total order at most seven and at most four colors; the general statement is analytic.
title: Singleton rainbow domination of complete multipartite graphs
